answer: Random beacon spot-checks and a compute heartbeat block hollow identities. Each agent posts a 20 POA bond and registers a cipher key; every epoch a public beacon picks 5% at random and demands a fresh proof echoed in 60 seconds. Forging 1,000 hollow shells costs 1,000 x 28 POA per epoch — 20 bond plus 8 compute — 28,000 POA in all. Honest agents pay once, keep the bond, earn unshared rewards; cheaters lose the bond and the echo slot.
